svg.title: Kumo — Character Model Sheet
svg.text: Official design reference · turnaround · proportions · expressions · construction · identity
SHEET KUMO-MS-01 · v2.0 · ART FROM THE APPROVED REFERENCE · 1 H = HEAD HEIGHT
· orthographic · same scale and ground line in every view
· eyes, lids, brow ridges and mouth only · the faceted head never changes
· Polyhedral head, no soft round surfaces
· Dark brown outlines, flat even lighting
Character art: approved Kumo reference renders (referencia de modelo/). Every illustration, animation and 3D model must match this sheet.
